resolved_findings.issue: Advancing callback during backward wall-clock movement could overwrite the prior later receipt and erase a clock-failure guard.
resolved_findings.resolution: _on_bar rejects nonfinite or future prior receipt before any buffer or freshness mutation.

resolved_findings.issue: Failed subscription could leave a connected stream attached while running=false and lose its reference on retry.
resolved_findings.resolution: False subscription results call stop; a retry cleans an existing reference before constructing another stream; failed disconnect retains the reference.

acceptance_checks: Bar callbacks require finite aware nonfuture event timestamps; older rows do not replace latest history or refresh receipt health.
Equal-timestamp corrections replace values without row growth or health renewal; delayed advancing history does not renew live freshness.
Subscribed-but-unseen symbols fail closed. All active stale symbols block entries despite fresh aggregate or quote-only traffic.
Confirmed local unsubscribe success removes bar/quote/receipt state and recomputes aggregate; failed unsubscribe retains guard; retired late callbacks are ignored until explicit re-add.

Callback mutation is synchronous after timestamp validation; no await permits interleaving within retirement checks and mutation. Under the locked policy, scheduler config updates are refused; no new concurrent configuration update path was introduced.
Missing quote subscription retries independently from successful bars. Recovery connection success never itself certifies bar freshness.
Clock/nonfinite freshness check exceptions set entry stale state; recovery log is emitted only after aggregate and per-symbol checks are both clear.
Current tick entry-blocker stage only flags entries. Protective exit and EOD processing remain before the entry-blocked return; exit helpers and final admission guard are unchanged by this delta.
REST fallback provides feature data without clearing the stream entry block.

W100/replay supplementary read confirms actual buy, losing protective close, EOD close, accounting and idempotence assertions; scanner integration clears pool on empty/error while preserving base and held universe.

independent_execution.method: Read final source/diffs, tests, JUnit and AST-only baseline comparison; no model loads.

limitations: This is bounded source acceptance, not deployed runtime or live subscription acknowledgement proof. Alpaca stream True means successful send/local tracking under its existing API contract, not a new server-ack protocol.

Receipt health for advancing bars retains the existing 120-second receipt semantics after checking event age at arrival; the separate final actual-feature admission guard remains required and unchanged.
A genuinely sparse active symbol may still hold the conservative global PP-6 entry block; no rule/threshold relaxation was approved.
All-unseen startup retains existing no-first-bar forced-reconnect grace while entry state remains blocked.
Synthetic replay and mocks establish mechanisms, not strategy expectancy, broker connectivity, or authenticated streaming performance.

Root owns final combined regression, frozen-surface verification/snapshot, PR/CI, and explicit new-cutoff deployment approval. Our scanner implementation is excluded from this independent source review.
